Denote by $\thetaopt \in \mM$ an unknown parameter vector, where $\mM \subset \RR^d$ is a known convex polytope with $\diam(\mM) \leq 1$. ... $\epsilon_t$ is sampled independently from a Gaussian with zero mean and unit variance. source.label: thm:regret-log
source.quote: The regret of Algorithm \ref{alg:ids-anytime} is bounded by $R_n \leq \oO\left(\Delta_{\min}^{-1} d^3\log(n)^2 \right)$.

results.notes: O hides universal constants and boundedness constants of X and M.

source.label: thm:regret-asymptotic
source.quote: Algorithm \ref{alg:ids-anytime} is asymptotically optimal, $\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \frac{R_n}{\log(n)} = c^*$, where $c^*$ is the solution to the lower bound \eqref{eq:lower-linear} and we assume that $\|x^*\| > 0$.

results.notes: Statement is an exact limit equal to c* (Graves-Lai constant); recorded as limsup upper bound, matching lower bound of Theorem 1.
